jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Build privacy and anonymization systems that make sensitive real-world data safer to use in AI training. You will develop and evaluate methods that protect sensitive information while preserving the structure and utility of data for downstream workflows. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive content, and select transformations suited to each data type and use case. - Develop and benchmark detection methods combining rules, statistical models, classifiers, and language models. - Create production pipelines that anonymize data before it enters processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data generation. - Build evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re-identification attempts. - Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema changes, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields. - Work with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical safeguards. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - A technical degree and at least 2 years building production data or machine learning systems in Python. - Hands-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII, including transforming it while preserving useful data characteristics. - Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related techniques for detecting rare or sensitive content. - Experience building end-to-end data processing pipelines and comparing approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost, and downstream utility. - Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data. - Experience handling sensitive data in healthcare, finance, security, or related fields is valuable. - Hands-on knowledge of privacy-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format-preserving encryption is valuable. - Experience with low-latency or high-throughput ML inference and data processing is valuable. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.

Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Ensure the resilience and scalability of our mission-critical applications by managing CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native services to guarantee seamless uptime under pressure. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with UI/UX designers, data engineers, and product managers to deliver seamless, high-quality digital experiences that meet the rigorous needs of analysts. Requirements A degree or professional qualification in Computer Science or a related field, with proven hands-on experience in software development. Proficiency in building dynamic, responsive user interfaces using React.js and the modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem. Proven experience building efficient, secure RESTful APIs with frameworks such as Express.js, Fastify, FastAPI, Spring Boot, or equivalent enterprise-grade tools. Hands-on experience managing data persistence and search layers using MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, or comparable NoSQL and search engines. Familiarity with common design patterns, writing scalable code, and successfully integrating services within complex, distributed systems. Nice to Have Exposure to cloud-native development and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes). Hands-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks. Prior experience building AI-enabled enterprise platforms, automation systems, or high-traffic applications. Familiarity with AI engineering, including integrations, prompt engineering, and embedding strategies. Exposure to advanced search architectures, specifically vector search, semantic search, and RAG patterns. Why Join Us? Work that matters: Your applications will directly support Singapore's national security by turning raw data into actionable insights. Cutting-edge tech: Gain hands-on experience deploying AI solutions and modern, cloud-native data technologies at meaningful scale. Collaborative culture: Join a talented team with a strong engineering ethos and a commitment to real work-life balance. Room to grow: We invest in our engineers, creating space for you to innovate in the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence. As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.
